تتدافعي (form VI)
# تَتَدَافَعِي (tatadāfaʕī) /ta.ta.daː.fa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُتَدَافَعِي (tutadāfaʕī) /tu.ta.daː.fa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
